name: Swad Gharcha Food Depot
description:
स्वाद घरचा (Swad Gharcha) is your go-to destination for authentic homemade-style Maharashtrian food and fresh seafood in Mumbai. We specialize in delicious fish fry, prawns curry, bombil fry, chicken dishes, and veg & non-veg thalis, all prepared with traditional recipes and high-quality ingredients.
If you’re searching for home-style food near you, best seafood in Mumbai, or fresh fish fry delivery, Swad Gharcha offers hygienic, flavorful meals with quick service. Our menu is crafted to bring you the comforting taste of “gharcha jevan” with every bite.
Order now for fresh, tasty, and affordable meals, perfect for lunch, dinner, and bulk orders.

featured_reviews.name: Mansha Pais
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been ordering meals from this place every day for the past month and it has been a consistently good experience. The portions are generous and they offer a nice variety like pav bhaji and puri bhaji on some days, to break the usual rice-and-dal routine. They even surprise you with a sweet dish occasionally. While the dry sabzi and gravy can be mildly spicy for some, the dal is exceptional and more than makes up for it. Delivery times can vary, but that is understandable given Santacruz East traffic. Overall, the food feels homely and I am more than happy to keep ordering from them.

featured_reviews.name: Ramsha Tausalkar
featured_reviews.review_text: There’s a new South Indian food spot in the city so I had to check it out. Nanna House in Bandra is serving Andhra style food and I tried their specials. The Karam Podi Dosa is your usual slick dosa, but with Karam Podi masala which was too spicy for me. The Pesarattu, a healthy moong dal dosa, was perfect though. I really enjoyed it. Another of their healthy offerings is the Millet Cone Idli, served in this very cute manner. It is plain and pasty, and a must try. All of this comes with 4 chutneys, each with their own kick. What you can’t miss here at all is their Filter Kaapi Soft Serve - it’s like creamy cold coffee. So good. Overall, this place offers unique and healthy options, so if that’s what you like, check it out.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hey, thank you for the wonderful and detailed feedback! We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed our Andhra-style dishes, from the Karam Podi Dosa and Pesarattu to the Millet Cone Idli. We’re especially glad the Filter Kaapi Soft Serve was a hit! Your kind words about our unique and healthy offerings mean a lot, and we look forward to welcoming you back soon for another great experience.

With regard,
Team Nānna House

featured_reviews.name: sucheta thakur
featured_reviews.review_text:
If there’s one place Bandra needs to start forming lines for, it’s @nannahouseindia on 16th Road. This Andhra-style spot is all set to change the way Bandra — actually, Bombay — experiences South Indian food. And yes, maybe it sounds like I’m exaggerating… but one meal here is enough to prove why I’m not.

From the moment the food arrived, everything reminded me of the kind of flavours that feel simple, comforting, yet absolutely unforgettable.

We started with the Pesarattu, beautifully stuffed with upma — a combination that instantly transported me back to Hyderabad. The texture, the seasoning, the warmth… it just hits in the most nostalgic way.

Next up was the star of the show: the Butter Masala Dosa. Cooked in Amul butter and finished with a generous dollop of white butter, this dosa is easily one of the best in Bombay. Crisp edges, a soft centre, flavour-packed masala — truly dosa heaven.

The Butter Podi Idli followed the same theme — soft idlis coated in podi and topped with white butter. Comforting, buttery, and delicious in every bite.

And of course, no South Indian meal is complete without Filter Coffee. Their version is strong, aromatic, and balanced — exactly how a proper filter coffee should be.

But the surprise winner? The Filter Coffee Soft Serve. Smooth, perfectly sweet, full of coffee flavour — honestly, the perfect end to this meal. I’d go back just for this. ❤️

In a city overflowing with restaurants, Nanna House India stands out for its authenticity, warmth, and flavour-packed dishes. What are you waiting for? This is the place Bandra needs queues for — and trust me, once you try it, you’ll understand why.

featured_reviews.name: Vardhita Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overall, the experience was okay, but they definitely need to work on their management. It was quite crowded, and the person handling it wasn’t able to manage things well. Plus, the kiosk machine for ordering and payment wasn’t working, which made it a bit inconvenient.
Food Feedback:
1) Karam Podi Dosa – Felt dry and was served cold.
2) Ghee Podi Idli – Hardly any podi, and the idli was way too soft — almost like it wasn’t cooked properly.
3) Millet Cone Idli – Nice and different, but they can totally skip the ice-cream stick.
4) Filter Kaapi – Tasted good, but sugar should be on the table. We had to ask twice before we got it.
5) Chutney – Would be great if they could increase the quantity a bit.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hey, thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We’re truly sorry that your experience didn’t meet expectations, and we sincerely apologize for the issues with crowd management, the kiosk, and some of the dishes. Your comments regarding the Karam Podi Dosa, Ghee Podi Idli, Millet Cone Idli, filter kaapi, and chutney quantities have been noted and will be shared with our culinary and operations teams for immediate improvement.

We appreciate your honest feedback as it helps us enhance both our food and service, and we hope to have the opportunity to provide you with a much better experience on your next visit.

With regard,
Team Nānna House

featured_reviews.name: Kinjal Jethwa
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am so in love with Andhra cuisine — those soft, soft idlis and dosas are my absolute weakness! I recently visited a new place that opened in Bandra, and it’s perfect for breakfast, lunch, or dinner.
The food here is pure bliss. The chutney, the sambhar — the authenticity is just amazing. The millet cone idli was my favourite!
We also tried their Ghee Podi Idli and Button Vada — so fresh and so yummy, I just couldn’t say no.
The Karam Masala Dosa was nice and crispy, and the Poori Saagu was absolutely ultimate.
Overall, the food is superb and I truly enjoyed every bit of it.
And lastly… Filter Coffee is a must before you wrap up your meal.
Do check this place out if you’re an idli fan just like me!
They have limited menu but super tasty 🤤
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for visiting us, we are happy to hear such kind words & hoping to serve you soon!

featured_reviews.name: Farhan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are searching for authentic Andhra food in Bandra, Nanna House is a place you should not miss. This South Indian cafe specialises in traditional Andhra cuisine, and the flavours truly reflect home-style cooking. The millet cone idlis were soft and wholesome, and the podi idlis had the perfect balance of ghee and spice.

The dosa selection is excellent. The karam podi dosa was spicy, crisp, and full of flavour, while the butter masala dosa was comforting and indulgent. Every dish felt freshly prepared and true to South Indian food traditions, making it one of the better South Indian restaurants in Bandra.

The highlight for me was the putharekulu dessert, a rare Andhra sweet that is difficult to find in Mumbai. Light, ghee-rich, and delicately sweet, it ended the meal beautifully. Add a cup of traditional filter coffee and the experience feels complete. Highly recommended for anyone looking for the best Andhra restaurant in Bandra.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hey, thank you for such a detailed and wonderful review! We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed our authentic Andhra flavors, from the millet cone idlis to the dosas and the special putharekulu dessert. It’s great to know that our food and traditional touches made your experience complete. Your kind words truly mean a lot, and we look forward to welcoming you back soon for another delicious meal.

With regard,
Team Nānna House

featured_reviews.review_text: Nice cozy ambience with awesome south indian food. All dishes tastes delicious and is priced appropriate for the pocket. Dont forget to try its Karam podi dosa, andhra style poori sagu, ghee dosa with authentic filter coffee….

Hey, thank you for the wonderful feedback! We’re delighted to hear you enjoyed our cozy ambience and authentic South Indian dishes. We’re glad the Karam Podi Dosa, Andhra-style Poori Sagu, Ghee Dosa, and filter coffee left a great impression. Can’t wait to welcome you back for another delicious meal!

With regard,
Team Nānna House

featured_reviews.name: 1TeaspoonLove
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nanna house is an Andhra style kitchen serving authentic Andhra food.
Small place, small menu but big on flavour.

The dishes are served with 4 types of chutneys and sambar.

The idlis were super soft almost melted in the mouth. We loved the Babai idli which were dipped in ghee topped with white butter. So good! The podi idli was good too.

We tried the Karam podi and pesarattu .. both were crisp and tasted good. The karam podi was garlicky and spicy.

We also tried the cone ragi idli which were decent.

The filter coffee was good but the filter coffee soft serve was excellent. Must try. It was smooth creamy and perfect.

Overall good food.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hey, thank you for the wonderful feedback! We’re thrilled to hear you enjoyed our authentic Andhra dishes, from the Babai idli and podi idli to the Karam Podi, pesarattu, and cone ragi idli. We’re especially glad the filter coffee soft serve was a hit! Your kind words about the food and flavours mean a lot, and we look forward to welcoming you back soon for another delicious experience.

With regard,
Team Nānna House

featured_reviews.name: Anita Kapai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Follow me on Instagram for more details
@kapaianita

A slice of Andhra in the heart of Bandra West 🤍
A newly opened South Indian spot in Bandra West bringing honest, homestyle Andhra flavours to the table — perfect for breakfast, lunch or dinner.

Some must-trys from the menu:
• Ghee Podi Idli — soft idlis tossed in fragrant podi with a generous drizzle of ghee.
• Babai Idli — pillowy idlis dunked in ghee and topped with butter… pure comfort.
• Millet Cone Idli — a healthier, cone-shaped twist on a classic.
• Pesarattu — crispy, savoury moong-dal dosa packed with herbs and flavour.
• Karam Podi Masala Dosa — a spicy Andhra-style dosa with a bold kick.

If you’re chasing simple, soulful, South Indian food — this place is highly recommended. 🌿✨
